item.title: 4 quick software tweaks to extend your phone’s battery life by 30 percent
item.description: Give your iPhone or Android a fighting chance to make it to bedtime on a single charge. Modern smartphones don’t run out of juice mid-afternoon because their batteries are defective. They run out because dozens of invisible background services are constantly running full-throttle in your pocket. Apps are pinging GPS satellites, pulling fresh data over weak cellular connections, and redrawing high-resolution screens 120 times per second....
